resource:76ad9eed-d076-46d6-96e2-a4eb8e0: skip: field-rename dictionary between the old and new report formats (46 rows of metadata), not data; by_schema excludes it
reports.FUND_ID: key: track identity for dedup across period files, kpi:tracks
reports.CONTROLLING_CORPORATION: skip: the controlling group of each managing body — one-to-one with the managing bodies already charted (chart-managers)
reports.REPORT_PERIOD: chart-assets, chart-yields, chart-rolling, chart-exposure, chart-flows, chart-fees, kpi:assets
reports.INCEPTION_DATE: skip: track launch dates are administrative (tracks are re-registered on mergers and format changes), so counts by launch year would not mean new products
reports.SPECIALIZATION: chart-spec, chart-spec-yield, chart-age, insight:spec — current snapshot only; the taxonomy was re-coded in 2024
reports.SUB_SPECIALIZATION: chart-age, insight:age — the age bands of the default (מדרגות) tracks; other sub-specializations repeat the main specialization
reports.TOTAL_ASSETS: chart-assets, chart-managers, chart-spec, chart-risk, insight:growth, kpi:assets
reports.AVG_DEPOSIT_FEE: chart-fees — reported by about 40% of tracks; disclosed in the chart note
reports.YIELD_TRAILING_3_YRS: skip: cumulative 3-year yield — the page uses its annualised twin (AVG_ANNUAL_YIELD_TRAILING_3YRS)
reports.YIELD_TRAILING_5_YRS: skip: cumulative 5-year yield — the page uses its annualised twin (AVG_ANNUAL_YIELD_TRAILING_5YRS)
reports.ALPHA: skip: alpha is measured against each track's own unpublished benchmark — not comparable across tracks
reports.MANAGING_CORPORATION_LEGAL_ID: skip: company registration number of the managing body — an identifier; the page uses the name
reports.REPORTING_YEAR: skip: duplicates the year part of REPORT_PERIOD (older files only)
reports.CURRENT_DATE: skip: file export timestamp (newest file only), not a data value
reports._resource_name: key: deterministic tie-break when a track-month appears in two period files
